cuda_matmul.note: torch.matmul on 1024x1024 CUDA tensors inside the container

self_contained_gpu_image.contents: debian:bookworm-slim + portable CPython 3.12.13 + torch 2.14.1+cu126 + torchaudio + onnxruntime-gpu==1.23.2 + pyannote.audio==4.0.0 + panns_inference==0.1.1 + kaldi-native-fbank

onnxruntime.note: 1.31.1 needs a CUDA 13 runtime and the PyPI nvidia-*-cu13 wheels are 0.0.1 placeholders; 1.23.2 is the last CUDA 12 build and matches torch cu126's bundled cuBLAS 12 / cuDNN 9. Scripts call onnxruntime.preload_dlls() and assert CUDAExecutionProvider in session.get_providers().

self_contained_gpu_image.working_invocation: docker run --rm --gpus all --network=none --user <uid>:<gid> [-e HOME=/tmp] -v /usr/lib/wsl/lib:/usr/lib/wsl/lib:ro -e LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/wsl/lib -v $PWD/data:/poc/data:ro -v $PWD/models:/poc/models:ro -v $PWD/results:/poc/results recording-mcp-audio-poc:gpu <script>

silero_vad.note: Per-chunk streaming loop dominates; GPU is slower than the CPU provider for this model.

panns_cnn14.note: Requires -e HOME=/tmp plus a read-only mount of the host panns_data labels/checkpoint for an offline run.

previous_cpu_image_with_host_venv.detail: Earlier GPU rows used recording-mcp-audio-poc:cpu with the host .venv-gpu mounted because the first self-contained build failed on a bad panns_inference pin.
